instructions: An offers package for a multi-tenant shop. Callers provide nonnegative prices and quantities, discount percentages from 0 through 100, and nonnegative page sizes and offsets. Cache instances are used by one goroutine. PageOffers must return every available item in the requested page, including a page ending exactly at the slice length. DiscountedCents applies the stated percentage discount to a cent total. TopOffers returns up to limit cheapest offers.

rules.rule: Round monetary order totals to the nearest cent only after multiplying the unit price by the quantity. Do not round each unit first.
Pass the caller context to every outbound quote lookup so cancellation and context values propagate.
A cached quote must be keyed by both tenant ID and SKU. One tenant must never read another tenant's cached quote.
Rank offers by ascending price. Preserve the original input order when prices tie.
Functions receiving an offer slice must not mutate the caller's slice or its elements.
An outbound quote lookup error must be wrapped with its original cause and include the operation and SKU.
